newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Sept official reserves fall to $17.55 bln.
newsitem.headline: Polish Sept official reserves fall to $17.55 bln.

text.p: Polish official foreign currency reserves, those held by the central bank, fell by $420 million in September to $17.55 billion but were $4.56 billion higher than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said official reserves grew $2.59 billion in the January-September period compared to a $6.96 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) SEPT 96 AUG 96 SEPT 95
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
